Introduction

RION FIVE was a three-member boy group under Narda Entertainment. Originally a five-member group, with the lineup consisting of Rohyoon, Minjae, Taewoo, Yousung, and Kangsan, the group debuted on March 25, 2014, with the digital single "Rion Five". During their second release, "Tuk Tuk Tuk", in February 2015, member Jeonghyeon was added.

Their fandom name, "Orib" is a combination of "Only", "Rion Five", and "Beauty".

In January 2018, Narda Entertainment decided to make a collaboration with Ideal Media Group to debut the project Korean-Chinese project group T.E.N, consisting of the RION FIVE members, as well as five other trainees.

Two months later, in March 2018, it was reported that Kangsan would no longer promote with the group due to personal reasons. The same year, members Rohyoon, Taewoo, and Minjae also left the group. The two remaining members, Jeonghyeon and Yousung, were announced to re-debut in the group Victory, a five-member boy group, but the debut plan eventually fell through, confirmed by the appearance of the Victory lineup at a festival under the name RION FIVE.

The group returned in September 2019, with the lineup now consisting of Yousung, Yonghun (previously a T.E.N member), Jungwon, Youngjik, and Minsung. However, they never released music with this lineup and, in 2021, the group appeared with three members: Yousung, Yonghun, and former member Jeonghyeon, that returned to the group.

In late 2021, RION FIVE joined Souls Entertainment as their previous agency was acquired by them. It was then reported that the group would make a comeback soon, but they remained inactive and eventually disbanded.
